title: CERT-In flags 4 flaws in hospital software
takeaways: 4 e-Sushrut HMIS flaws flagged by CERT-In on 17 Nov 2026.
Worst flaw scores 8.7 on CVSS v4.0, no login needed.
Ransomware on Indian healthcare providers rose 700% in H1 2026.
India's average data breach now costs ₹25.5 crore.
Extensive automation: ₹21.3 crore per breach vs ₹31.6 crore with none.
source_note: Sources: CERT-In; OpenCVE; Comparitech H1 2026; IBM 2026 via IANS
